sections.text: Swiss voters overwhelmingly rejected a proposal backed by the Swiss People's Party (SVP) to enshrine a stricter definition of armed neutrality into the constitution. sections.text: The vote allows Switzerland to continue cooperating with Nato and maintaining sanctions against Russia following its invasion of Ukraine. sections.heading: What happened
sections.text: A massive El Niño has broken temperature records, with sea surface temperatures in the Pacific reaching past highs. It is a natural climate pattern where the east Pacific becomes warmer and wetter, layered on top of human-caused global heating.

sections.heading: Why it matters
sections.text: The combination of global heating and El Niño exacerbates extreme weather like droughts and floods. This causes huge disruptions to agriculture and the global economy, particularly affecting poorer countries.

sections.heading: What happens next
sections.text: Forecast systems can now predict El Niño events months ahead, allowing farmers and governments to prepare. Scientists note that impacts and rainfall responses will likely grow larger over coming decades.
